_comment: IGNIS MCP server. Runs the `ignis-mcp` bin that @vaultspark/ignis-core installs on this machine (install once: `npm i -g <path-to-vaultspark-ignis-checkout>`). `--no-install` is load-bearing: an unrelated public npm package is also named ignis-mcp, and without this flag npx would download and run it whenever the local bin is missing. Portable — no absolute local paths (public-repo sanitization).
